Container.Name: Mnemo
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: ai assistant bot chatbot llm claude openai ollama mnema talk
Container.Overview: The helper bot for your Mnema Talk server. Ask it in chat and it answers with live weather, exact maths, time zones, unit conversion and Wikipedia. You bring your own AI provider and key (Anthropic, OpenAI, or a local model through an OpenAI-compatible server such as Ollama); there are daily token and cost limits so the bill stays boring. Needs a Mnema Talk server 3.1 or newer on which you are the owner. Add Mnemo in Talk first (Admin area, Bots), copy the token, then fill in this template. Guide: https://github.com/mnema-xyz/talk-mnemo-bot/blob/main/README.md#install-on-unraid
Container.Description:
Mnemo is a self-hosted AI helper for Mnema Talk.
- Mention it or use /ask: weather, calculator, time zones, units, Wikipedia - Threads with memory, Regenerate and Follow up buttons - Your provider, your key: Anthropic, OpenAI or a local model - Per-member and per-channel rate limits and a daily token or cost budget - Admin-only /details shows what was sent where
**Before you start:** add Mnemo to your Talk server under Admin area, Bots (Add from manifest) and copy the bot token, which is shown once. No AI account yet? Set the provider to fake for a dry run that costs nothing.

Config.Name: Talk server URL
Config.Description: The public address of your Mnema Talk server, the one members open. Required.

Config.Name: Bot token
Config.Description: The bot token Talk showed once when you added Mnemo (Admin area, Bots). Required.

Config.Name: AI provider
Config.Description: anthropic (default), openai, openai-compatible (Ollama, OpenRouter, LM Studio, vLLM) or fake (no AI, echoes the question, for a free dry run).

Config.Name: AI API key
Config.Description: Your key from the provider's console. Not needed for a local server or the fake provider.

Config.Name: AI model
Config.Description: Empty = claude-haiku-5-5 for Anthropic (fast, cheapest). Required for the other providers, for example gpt-5-mini or an Ollama model name.

Config.Name: Provider base URL
Config.Description: Required for openai-compatible, for example http://192.168.1.10:11434/v1 for Ollama. Leave empty otherwise.

Config.Name: Appdata path
Config.Description: Keeps the day's token count across restarts, so a restart cannot reset the budget.

Config.Name: Daily token budget
Config.Description: Tokens (input and output) per UTC day; 0 = no limit. The default is roughly ten cents a day on the default model.

Config.Name: Daily cost budget (USD)
Config.Description: US dollars per UTC day; 0 = no limit.

Config.Name: Allowed channels
Config.Description: Comma-separated channel IDs where Mnemo answers. Empty = every channel it can see.

Config.Name: Send display name
Config.Description: Tell the AI provider the asker's display name.

Config.Name: Read attachments
Config.Description: Let Mnemo read images, PDFs and text files up to 10 MB, after the owner of the file consents.

Config.Name: Web search provider
Config.Description: Optional web search. Needs the search key below; empty = off.
